items.title: [2026-07-05] Your marketplace shouldn't charge you (Image Prompt)
items.content:
SCENE: A clean, editorial poster-style hero for a nationwide Indian marketplace brand, flat design, no gradients.
SUBJECT: A single oversized rupee-zero symbol (₹0) as the hero motif, paired with a confident manifesto headline “Your marketplace shouldn't charge you.” Convey trust, warmth and value-consciousness — an owner-direct, zero-fee promise for all of India.
PHONE-UI MOCKUP: A minimal smartphone floating lower-right showing the QckServe app — a simple listing card with a bold ‘₹0 to list’ badge, a ‘Chat with owner’ button, and category chips (Properties, Vehicles, Jobs, Services, Store). Clean sans UI, generous whitespace.
COLOUR SYSTEM: flat colour blocking only — QckServe orange #ef6723 and #FF6B00 accent, near-black #1A1A1A, warm off-white #FCF9F8, pure #FFFFFF. One accent used sparingly. No gradients, no glow.
LIGHTING: soft even studio light, gentle contact shadow under the phone, matte surfaces, no harsh speculars.
TYPE HIERARCHY: one extra-bold condensed all-caps headline (Poppins) with tight letter-spacing, a small italic-serif kicker for contrast, and a tiny label row ‘Zero commission · Owner-direct · No middlemen’.
EYE FLOW: kicker → giant ₹0 → headline → phone mockup → CTA at the bottom.
CAMERA: straight-on flat-lay / poster composition, 50mm equivalent, no perspective distortion, centered balance.
PERFORMANCE LAYER: thumb-stopping single focal device (the giant ₹0), high figure-ground contrast, reads at a glance in a feed.
Reserve a ~140px TOP-LEFT square as empty negative space for the logo — logo placed manually. Real text baked minimally; keep composition breathable.
